mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, the temperature is 69 degrees with a feels like temperature of 73 at Badger Prairie County Park under a waning crescent moon.

The City of Verona provides ongoing engineering reports to the Council regarding infrastructure projects. Additionally, residents can now apply for the rain barrel rebate program to help reduce stormwater runoff and save water.

Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Starting tomorrow, we have plenty of options including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and the Bogey Factory, along with the downtown Farmer's Market.
On Thursday, an officer conducted a traffic stop for a vehicle with no lights that resulted in the driver being taken into custody for an outstanding arrest warrant.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Georgia Peach flavor of the day. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so be sure to stop by then.
